description: This file sets MAC addresses for specific Zyxel boards during pre-initialization, modifying Ethernet interface MAC addresses based on U-Boot environment variables.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for Ethernet interfaces eth0 and eth1 based on board type and MAC address retrieved from U-Boot environment.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address
ip link set dev eth1 address
